title: RTPS: Adding support for TypeLookup Service (OMG DDS XTypes 1.3 Spec)
description:
- Dissecting TypeLookup Service requests and replies.
- Dissecting TypeInformation in Data(r) and Data(w) messages.
- Dissecting flags in new PID_AVAILABLE_BUILTIN_ENDPOINTS_EXT.
- Dissecting four endpoint flags that were formerly reserved in
  PID_BUILTIN_ENDOINT_SET.
- Added rtps_util_add_string_no_align which does not attempt to perform
  alignment after parsing the string. Also only adds the string length to the
  tree when enable_debug_info is set.
- Adding a debug preference to display serialization data that will not be
  useful to typical users.
- Modified the text for user data dissection to clarify that it is only
  supported for version one of the TypeObject.
- Some parts of the standard are still not dissected: annotations, bitmasks,
  bitsets, and strongly connected components.

notes.body: changed the description

- To view PID_BUILTIN_SET changes, use a filter of rtps on either minimal-types,pcapng or complete-types.pcapng and view Data(p) messages.
- To view PID_AVAILABLE_BUILTIN_ENDPOINTS_EXT, use a filter of rtps on PID_AVAILABLE_EXT.pcapng and view Data(p) messages.
- To view TypeInformation changes, use a filter of rtps.param.id == 0x0075 on either minimal-types,pcapng or complete-types.pcapng and look for PID_TYPE_INFORMATION.
- To view TypeLookupService requests Data(trq) and replies Data(trp), use a filter of rtps.sm.wrEntityId == 0x000300c3 || rtps.sm.wrEntityId == 0x000301c3 on either minimal-types,pcapng or complete-types.pcapng.
